reviews.title: Reliable, quality, RGB memory at a fair price.
reviews.comment: I have used Kingston memory for about 20 years. Never had a single issue. The used to be considered the top end. There are many brands that are high quality now but I stick with the ones that have been good to me over the years. The RGB was the first for me on these but it works great. These run at the advertised speed like they should and have no issues in my AM5 build. Be sure to check the compatibility charts for both your motherboard and processor that it supports the speed of the memory modules you are buying.
